Subject: Grant Inquiry -- The STEAMery, Brown County, Indiana

Dear Dream Work Foundation Inc Grants Team,

My name is Kirstie Tiernan, and I am the founder of The STEAMery, a new
501(c)(3) nonprofit in Nashville, Indiana (Brown County). We are working to
convert a historic 1920s sock factory into a hands-on STEAM education facility
serving rural youth and the broader community in one of Indiana's most
economically under-resourced counties.

Based on Dream Work Foundation Inc's focus on community development, I believe our mission is closely aligned with your grantmaking priorities.


We are in the early stages of our capital campaign and would welcome the
opportunity to learn more about Dream Work Foundation Inc's current grantmaking priorities
and whether our work might be a good fit for your support. I'd love to share
a one-page project summary or schedule a brief call at your convenience.

Thank you sincerely for your time and for the meaningful work Dream Work Foundation Inc does
in [their community / Indiana / the region -- customize].

With warm regards,
Kirstie Tiernan

Subject: Grant Inquiry -- The STEAMery, Brown County, Indiana

Dear Mark And Marcia Lasiter Family Foundation Grants Team,

My name is Kirstie Tiernan, and I am the founder of The STEAMery, a new
501(c)(3) nonprofit in Nashville, Indiana (Brown County). We are working to
convert a historic 1920s sock factory into a hands-on STEAM education facility
serving rural youth and the broader community in one of Indiana's most
economically under-resourced counties.

Based on Mark And Marcia Lasiter Family Foundation's focus on community development, I believe our mission is closely aligned with your grantmaking priorities.


We are in the early stages of our capital campaign and would welcome the
opportunity to learn more about Mark And Marcia Lasiter Family Foundation's current grantmaking priorities
and whether our work might be a good fit for your support. I'd love to share
a one-page project summary or schedule a brief call at your convenience.

Thank you sincerely for your time and for the meaningful work Mark And Marcia Lasiter Family Foundation does
in [their community / Indiana / the region -- customize].

With warm regards,
Kirstie Tiernan
Founder, The STEAMery
Nashville, Indiana 47448

serving rural youth and the broader community in one of Indiana's most
economically under-resourced counties.

Subject: Grant Inquiry -- The STEAMery, Brown County, Indiana

Dear Aote Foundation Grants Team,

My name is Kirstie Tiernan, and I am the founder of The STEAMery, a new
501(c)(3) nonprofit in Nashville, Indiana (Brown County). We are working to
convert a historic 1920s sock factory into a hands-on STEAM education facility
serving rural youth and the broader community in one of Indiana's most
economically under-resourced counties.

Based on Aote Foundation's focus on education, I believe our mission is closely aligned with your grantmaking priorities.


We are in the early stages of our capital campaign and would welcome the
opportunity to learn more about Aote Foundation's current grantmaking priorities
and whether our work might be a good fit for your support. I'd love to share
a one-page project summary or schedule a brief call at your convenience.

Thank you sincerely for your time and for the meaningful work Aote Foundation does
in [their community / Indiana / the region -- customize].

With warm regards,
Kirstie Tiernan
Founder, The STEAMery
Nashville, Indiana 47448

My name is Kirstie Tiernan, and I am the founder of The STEAMery, a new
